Thin SPICE seat for the check-cardwire-vm bed — a sway (wlroots)
compositor session rendering a ghostty terminal on the virtio-gpu
head of the cachyos-gpu-vm substrate, so the host-side plugin-spice
probes (status / screenshot / type) drive the "SPICE terminal"
surface the plan's Phase 3 calls for. No KDE — the minimal seat that
makes the SPICE terminal real: an operator-visible, typeable terminal
on the SPICE display. require:s plugin-spice so the bed's host-side
`spice:` check verbs resolve (mirrors candy/cachyos-gpu-desktop-check).

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | enable seatd + seat group for the login user (sway needs a seat) |
| `run` | launch the sway + ghostty SPICE-terminal session for the login user |
| `check` | the sway seat is running (the SPICE terminal's compositor) |
| `check` | ghostty is present (the SPICE terminal) |
